items.title: Should You Buy Intel Stock For The Chips It Cannot Yet Make Enough Of?
items.summary: Intel (INTC) stock has returned about 295% over the past year, but it has given back 22% over the past three months. It trades roughly 31% below its 52-week high. The question now is what powers the next leg, and the answer is what Intel can build, not what it can sell.
